concept: Nugget Cat — warm pixel-art snack break
embed_cover_note: Quiet plum cat/nugget silhouettes, gold separator lines and a small bottom tagline complement the banner without repeating its logo. Upload as embedded-game background for click-to-launch; the center is reserved for itch.io's launch button.
preview_note: Illustrative layout, not a live itch.io capture. Use readable body typography in the actual editor.

background_display.size: native size, no stretch or cover

typography.note: Select via itch.io's Google Fonts picker. Pixel logo lettering is already baked into the banner.

layout.screenshots: Hidden (single column); embed selected screenshots in description

generation: Offline composition of existing artwork; no new AI request. Run tools/prepare_itch_game.gd with Godot.
disclosure: Game images and music use AI generation. Crowd/gulp audio consists of separate CC0 recordings credited in README and art_sources/reactions.json. Carry these disclosures and sound links into the game-page description.
